item.title: Feds seize meth, counterfeit pills in Lowell-Somerville raids
item.description: BOSTON — A Lowell home played a central role in an investigation that resulted in the arrest of two men accused of producing methamphetamine-laced counterfeit Adderall, as federal agents seized tens of thousands of pills, 30 pounds of crystal meth, and several firearms.

item.title: At least 3 detained in Nancy Guthrie case, still no arrests made
item.description: Heavy police activity in Tucson late Friday night resulted in at least three people being detained in connection to Nancy Guthrie's disappearance, but ended without any arrests.

item.title: Obama speaks out on Trump’s racist ape post, rips social media ‘clown show’
item.description: Barack Obama finally spoke out on the racist video posted by President Trump, dismissing it as part of a "clown show" playing out on social media.
